Research update

Presented PEARL at the 2026 Joint Mathematics Meetings

January 6, 2026

I attended the 2026 Joint Mathematics Meetings in Washington, D.C., where I gave a talk in the SIAM Minisymposium on Recent Advances in Numerical Linear Algebra. I presented our work, PEARL: Preconditioner Enhancement through Actor-critic Reinforcement Learning, which develops a reinforcement learning approach for learning matrix preconditioners.
